mapper.sql: mc.member_coupon_id,mc.coupon_id,mc.member_id, case when mc.status='AVAILABLE' and t.valid_to<now() then 'EXPIRED' else mc.status end member_status, mc.lock_order_id,mc.used_order_id,mc.receive_time,mc.lock_time,mc.used_time, t.coupon_name,t.scope_type,t.threshold_amount,t.discount_amount,t.status template_status,t.valid_from,t.valid_to
mapper.select: select from mall_coupon_template t where t.status='PUBLISHED' and t.valid_to>now() and t.claimed_quantity<t.total_quantity and not exists(select 1 from mall_member_coupon mc where mc.coupon_id=t.coupon_id and mc.member_id=#{memberId}) order by t.valid_to,t.coupon_id desc
select from mall_coupon_template where coupon_id=#{couponId} for update
select count(1) from mall_member_coupon where coupon_id=#{couponId} and member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: update mall_coupon_template set claimed_quantity=claimed_quantity+1,version=version+1,update_time=now() where coupon_id=#{couponId} and version=#{version} and status='PUBLISHED' and claimed_quantity<total_quantity

update mall_member_coupon mc join mall_coupon_template t on t.coupon_id=mc.coupon_id set mc.status='LOCKED',mc.lock_order_id=#{orderId},mc.lock_time=now(),mc.update_time=now() where mc.member_coupon_id=#{memberCouponId} and mc.member_id=#{memberId} and mc.status='AVAILABLE' and t.status='PUBLISHED' and now() between t.valid_from and t.valid_to

update mall_member_coupon mc join mall_order_coupon oc on oc.member_coupon_id=mc.member_coupon_id set mc.status='USED',mc.used_order_id=oc.order_id,mc.used_time=now(),mc.update_time=now(), oc.status='USED',oc.update_time=now() where oc.order_id=#{orderId} and mc.status='LOCKED' and oc.status='LOCKED'

update mall_member_coupon mc join mall_order_coupon oc on oc.member_coupon_id=mc.member_coupon_id set mc.status='AVAILABLE',mc.lock_order_id=null,mc.lock_time=null,mc.update_time=now(), oc.status='RELEASED',oc.update_time=now() where oc.order_id=#{orderId} and mc.status='LOCKED' and oc.status='LOCKED'
mapper.select: select oc.order_coupon_id orderCouponId,oc.order_id orderId,oc.order_no orderNo, oc.member_coupon_id memberCouponId,oc.coupon_id couponId,oc.coupon_name couponName, oc.scope_type scopeType,oc.threshold_amount thresholdAmount,oc.discount_amount discountAmount, oc.status status from mall_order_coupon oc join mall_order o on o.order_id=oc.order_id where oc.order_id=#{orderId} and o.member_id=#{memberId}

select from mall_coupon_template where (#{keyword} is null or #{keyword}='' or coupon_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and (#{status} is null or #{status}='' or status=#{status}) order by create_time desc,coupon_id desc
select target_id from mall_coupon_scope where coupon_id=#{couponId} order by scope_id
mapper.update: update mall_coupon_template set coupon_name=#{couponName},scope_type=#{scopeType},threshold_amount=#{thresholdAmount}, discount_amount=#{discountAmount},total_quantity=#{totalQuantity},valid_from=#{validFrom},valid_to=#{validTo}, remark=#{remark},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now(),version=version+1 where coupon_id=#{couponId} and status='DRAFT'
update mall_coupon_template set status=#{status},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now(),version=version+1 where coupon_id=#{couponId} and status in ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED','PAUSED')
